Definition: leftpad n a l = replicate (n - length l) a ++ l.

So length (replicate (n - length l) a ++ l) = length (replicate (n - length l) a) + length l (by length_append).

Length of replicate (n - length l) a is (n - length l) (by length_replicate).

Thus length (leftpad n a l) = (n - length l) + length l.

We need to show (n - length l) + length l = max n (length l).

This is exactly Nat.sub_add_eq_max with a = n, b = length l.

Thus we can rewrite using that lemma.
